name: Viridescent-Hollow
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
